$comment: SCHEMA PLACEHOLDER — the Lore Directory's text. Reorganised from docs/TOWN_BIBLE.md and the cards' own flavor and backstories in spec/maker_card_set.json; it invents nothing. Structure: story.sections[] (the game's tale, both places together); settings.capital and settings.boroughs (each place on its own: history[] then places[]); relationships[] (pairs and groups of characters, from the bible's Relationships); characterNotes{} (optional per-character cross-links). Any `cards` array holds card ids from maker_card_set.json; any `characters` array holds character names from its `characters` list; any `places` array holds refs of the form 'capital:<placeId>' or 'boroughs:<placeId>'.
